designer.title: Design your own door
designer.description: Choose the size, wood, colour and carving. See the door and its price instantly.
designer.order: I like it, place an order
designer.noStock: Wood is not available right now. Please call us.
designer.name: Full name
designer.successNote: We will call you soon to confirm.
designer.disclaimer: Price is an estimate. Final price is confirmed after measurement.
designer.payInfo: You can pay an advance now by bKash or Nagad and enter the transaction ID. We will verify it and confirm your order.
designer.photoTitle: A carving from your own photo
designer.photoSub: Seen a door you liked? Photograph the carving and we will put it on yours.
designer.photoPick: Photo of a door, or of a carving
designer.photoTip: Light from the side works far better than a straight-on flash. A carving is read through the shadow in its grooves, and a flat front light leaves no shadow to read.
designer.photoCorners: Drag the four dots so they hold the carved area only. The tighter the box, the cleaner the carving comes out.
designer.photoNothing: Nothing came out of this photo. Open Adjust and raise the detail, or try a photo with clearer shadows.
designer.photoNotFinal: The price we show for your own carving is an estimate only — nobody has priced this exact carving yet. Send the request and we will check it and give you the final price.
designer.estimatedNote: One line here is an estimate: your own carving has never been priced. Everything else — wood, colour, frame, labour — is our fixed rate and will not change. Send the request and we will send you the final price for the carving.
designer.successQuote: We will check your carving and send you the final price. You will see it on your own page, and you can place the order from there.
